QuestInfo.name: [Mushroom Castle] Up On The Walls 2
QuestInfo.0: The mushrooms seem to be losing to the Vikings again. The Head Security Officer wants your help again.
QuestInfo.1: The mushroom soldiers are having trouble handling flying enemies. Help them defeat the Vikings.
QuestInfo.2: You were able to push back the Vikings once again. The 'shrooms are trying their best, but it seems it's only a matter of time until the castle is overrun.

0.0: We... kinda never trained our soldiers against flying threats. I mean, nothing scary around here flies! We're doing our best but it's not looking good. Can you protect our castle walls once more?

yes.0: The walls on the other side of the castle are also under attack. Please go defeat the #r#o3300103##k monsters. We'd already be Viking fodder if not for you!

no.0: It's not like you could leave now if you wanted to. Just help us out while you have the chance.

1.0: Did you drive the Vikings from our castle walls?

yes.0: At this rate, the castle walls will be completely overrun. We've relocated some of our soldiers from the front gates to the rear, but we only have so many mushrooms to work with.

default.0: Please eliminate the #r#o3300103##k monsters trying to take over our castle walls.
